label: Whoobe object events
info:
EXAMPLE ONLY - NOT PART OF THE WHOOBE DISTRIBUTION.
Receives an object event from Whoobe (POST /whoobe-events), answers 200 at once, then writes a note back on the record through an API client. Needs the environment variables WHOOBE_CLIENT_URL (the Gateway's client API as this container sees it, e.g. http://172.17.0.1:3001/client/v1) and WHOOBE_KEY (the API client's key). Optional: WHOOBE_SIGNING_SECRET to check X-Whoobe-Signature.
